core_obligations: For each point s of S choose an i with s in the image of S_i -> S.
Apply the neighbourhood lemma to obtain T_s -> S flat, finitely presented, locally quasi-finite, through s, facturing through S_i.
Conclude {T_s -> S} is an fppf covering refining the given one.

proof_roadmap.step: Build a chart T_s -> S through every point via the neighbourhood lemma.
Check the assembled family is an fppf covering that refines the original.

difficulty_reason: Given an fppf covering of a scheme S, the lemma produces a refining fppf covering all of whose maps are locally quasi-finite, i.e. the locally quasi-finite flat finite presentation maps already generate the fppf topology. The retained proof is written out: for each s in S pick an index i with s in the image of S_i -> S, apply the neighbourhood lemma (lemma-qf-fp-flat-neighbourhood-dominates-fppf) to get a map g_s : T_s -> S that is flat, locally of finite presentation, locally quasi-finite, has s in its image and factors through S_i -> S, and verify the resulting family {T_s -> S} is an fppf covering refining the original one. Retained author proof at lines 6476-6484.
